label: Story page: rules growth chart
description: The 'Rules added on Rulezet since its creation' chart of /history_logo. The total at the end is the real number of rules of the instance; the curve before it is an illustration of the growth, shown as such on the page. start — the month the chart starts (Rulezet's launch); spikes — months that weigh more (launch, big imports, key contributions); events — key moments marked on the curve (month YYYY-MM, a short label, a longer text shown on hover).

events.label: Launch
events.text: The idea of Alexandre Dulaunoy, head of CIRCL, becomes an internship project.
